given.note: The kind matcher's catalog, read as T-633's matchKinds hands it to T-632's matcher (README item 78), ten minutes after Sam's NEW 'pack hikes' for the pet boarding business was drafted (K-24's seed-new-work-draft). K-24's seed-kinds-sample gives the catalog eight of fixture set v1's 243 trade-file kinds (barber, plumber, electrician, yoga, movers, boarding, dog-walker and insurance), each at version 1; they are answered in id order, compared byte by byte, with their id, name, style, pattern and source, and never their facts. The drafted kind new-pack-hikes, source new_work, is in the same table and is never answered: v1 keeps a drafted kind to its owner, and the matcher offers only trade_file kinds (K-24 README line 96). The request names no business: the catalog is shared, and the same eight rows answer under any business's scope and under none.
